traps.title: Unresolved Git Merge Conflict Marker
traps.forbidden_claim_or_action: Leaving unresolved git merge conflict markers in source, configuration, or documentation files.
traps.remediation_atom: Resolve all merge conflict branches completely and run git diff --check before committing.

fixtures.positive:

=======

>>>>>>> main

traps.title: Silent Broad Exception Pass
traps.forbidden_claim_or_action: Swallowing broad Exception or BaseException blocks with a silent pass statement.
traps.remediation_atom: Catch narrow exception tuples (such as OSError or ValueError) and handle or log failures explicitly per ruff S110.

traps.title: Unscoped Type Ignore Comment
traps.forbidden_claim_or_action: Using bare # type: ignore comments without scoping the specific error code in brackets.
traps.remediation_atom: Resolve the static type mismatch or scope the suppression to an explicit code like # type: ignore[attr-defined] per mypy ignore-without-code and ruff PGH003.

traps.title: Unjustified TypeScript Directive Suppression
traps.forbidden_claim_or_action: Suppressing TypeScript compiler diagnostics with bare // @ts-ignore or // @ts-nocheck without an inline rationale.
traps.remediation_atom: Fix the type error or replace with @ts-expect-error followed by a root-cause rationale per @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment.

traps.title: Empty Promise Catch Handler
traps.forbidden_claim_or_action: Swallowing rejected promises with an empty .catch(() => {}) callback.
traps.remediation_atom: Log diagnostic context, return a typed fallback value, or rethrow inside promise catch handlers per @typescript-eslint/no-empty-function.

fixtures.negative: await syncRemoteState().catch((err) => { console.error('sync failed', err); throw err; });

traps.title: Unjustified Skipped Test
traps.forbidden_claim_or_action: Skipping tests without a tracked reason via @unittest.skip(""), bare @pytest.mark.skip, it.skip(), test.skip(), or bare #[ignore].
traps.remediation_atom: Fix the failing test or document a tracked reason using skip(reason=...) in Python, eslint-plugin-jest/no-disabled-tests rules in JS/TS, or clippy::ignore_without_reason in Rust.

traps.title: Blanket Linter Suppression
traps.forbidden_claim_or_action: Using bare # noqa, bare // eslint-disable, or bare // nolint comments without scoping specific rule codes.
traps.remediation_atom: Fix the underlying diagnostic or scope the suppression to an explicit rule code (such as # noqa: E501) per ruff PGH004, eslint-comments/no-unlimited-disable, and nolintlint.

traps.title: Unresolved Citation or Verification Placeholder
traps.forbidden_claim_or_action: Leaving unresolved [CITATION NEEDED], TODO: cite, or [UNVERIFIED] placeholders in Markdown documentation.
traps.remediation_atom: Replace placeholder tags with a verified primary-source citation, file-and-line reference, or [INFERENCE: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH] uncertainty label.
